fieldValues.body:
Cross-cutting unit from the read-through (§4, unit X3). Depended on X2 (terminology current before the contract is written).

Rewrote Part 1's prose to name the reader, list the nine Parts in one line each, and state the two governing facts: records are the source, documents are projections. Moved the extension-decision table (previously opening the Part) to the end, near Extensions.

PR: https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/pull/823 (merged).
